subject.title: refactor: deduplicate micro helpers onto canonical homes

question: Should this 63-file helper consolidation land after a maintainer confirms the selected canonical helpers preserve each caller’s intentionally different semantics and the contributor supplies a representative real-runtime smoke proof?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and broad cross-subsystem surface make acceptance a human judgment even though no discrete patch defect was established.

options.title: Review after rebase and runtime smoke
options.body: Refresh the branch against current main, provide redacted live behavior output for representative paths, then approve only substitutions confirmed to preserve their local contracts.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Split the change into smaller helper-family batches if maintainers prefer easier semantic review and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Review after rebase and runtime smoke
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current main, provide redacted live behavior output for representative paths, then approve only substitutions confirmed to preserve their local contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the proposed consolidation and is the only directly evidenced follow-up contact in the supplied PR context.
